content: पर्वन् {%n.%} [पॄ-वनिप् <ls>Uṇ. 4. 112.</ls>] ‘पर्व स्यादुत्सवे ग्रन्थौ प्रस्तावे लक्षणान्तरे’ इति विश्वः .²1 A knot, joint; मासाश्चार्धमासाश्च पर्वाणि; <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 1. 1</ls>. (Sometimes changed to पर्व at the end of <ab>Bah. comp.</ab>; as in कर्कशाङ्गुलिपर्वया <ls>R. 12. 41.</ls>) सोऽहं दुर्मायिनस्तेऽद्य वज्रेण शतपर्वणा, शिरो हरिष्ये <ls>Bhāg. 8. 11. 6</ls>; सतामिवापर्वणि मार्गणानाम् <ls>Ki. 17. 29</ls>. .²2 A limb, member, joint of the body, knuckle. .²3 A portion, part, division; ससर्ज च्छायया विद्यां पञ्चपर्वाणमग्रतः <ls>Bhāg. 3. 20. 18</ls>. .²4 A book, section (as of the Mahābhārata). .²5 The step of a staircase; दिने दिने शैवलवन्त्यधस्तात् सोपानपर्वाणि विमुञ्चदम्भः <ls>R. 16. 46</ls>. .²6 A period, fixed time. .²7 Particularly, the days of the four changes of the moon; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} the eighth and fourteenth day of each half month and the days of the full and new moon. .²8 A sacrifice performed on the occasion of a change of the moon; पर्वणि न विचिन्वेत् (तुलसीम्) <ls>Tulasī. Up.</ls> .²9 The day of new or full moon, the day of opposition or conjunction; अपर्वणि ग्रहकलुषेन्दुमण्डला विभावरी कथय कथं भविष्यति <ls>M. 4. 15</ls>; <ls>R. 7. 33</ls>; <ls>Ms. 4. 150</ls>; <ls>Bh. 2. 34</ls>. .²10 An eclipse of the sun or moon; भ्रातः पर्वणि पश्य दानवपतिः शीर्षावशेषी कृतः <ls>Bh.</ls> .²11 A festival, holiday, an occasion of joy; स्वलंकृतौ बालगजौ पर्वणीव सितेतरौ (कृष्णरामौ) <ls>Bhāg. 10. 41. 41</ls>. .²12 An opportunity or occasion in general. .²13 A particular period of the year (as the equinox, solstice). .²14 The moment of the sunʼs entering a new sign. .²15 A moment, instant.
